TrafficLaw.title: TrafficLaw
TrafficLaw.description: Represents a specific law or regulation related to traffic in Vietnam.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Traffic Law.

lawCode.description: The official code or number of the law (e.g., Nghị định 100/2019/NĐ-CP).

title.description: The descriptive title of the traffic law.

content.description: The full text content of the law or regulation.

publicationDate.description: The date when the law was officially published.

effectiveDate.description: The date when the law came into effect.

UserQuery.title: UserQuery
UserQuery.description: Represents a user's question or query related to traffic laws.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User Query.

queryText.description: The actual text of the user's query.

timestamp.description: The date and time when the query was submitted.

LawBotResponse.title: LawBotResponse
LawBotResponse.description: Represents the chatbot's response to a user's query, including the summarized answer and references.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Law Bot Response.

userQueryId.description: Reference to the UserQuery that this response is for. (Relationship: UserQuery 1:N LawBotResponse)

responseText.description: The summarized answer generated by the chatbot.

trafficLawIds.description: References to TrafficLaws used to compose the response. (Relationship: TrafficLaw N:N LawBotResponse)

timestamp.description: The date and time when the response was generated.

Feedback.title: Feedback
Feedback.description: Represents user feedback on the chatbot's responses.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Feedback entry.

lawBotResponseId.description: Reference to the LawBotResponse that the feedback is related to. (Relationship: LawBotResponse 1:N Feedback)

rating.description: A numerical rating of the response (e.g., 1-5 stars).

comment.description: Optional free-text comment providing more details about the feedback.

timestamp.description: The date and time when the feedback was submitted.

definition.description: Stores traffic law data. Each document represents a specific law or regulation.  No authorization needed as this is public read.

params.name: trafficLawId
params.description: The unique identifier for the traffic law.

definition.description: Stores user queries. No authorization needed as this is public read.

params.name: userQueryId
params.description: The unique identifier for the user query.

definition.description: Stores chatbot responses to user queries. No authorization needed as this is public read.

params.name: lawBotResponseId
params.description: The unique identifier for the law bot response.

definition.description: Stores user feedback on chatbot responses.  No authorization needed as this is public read.

params.name: feedbackId
params.description: The unique identifier for the feedback entry.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to support the traffic law chatbot application. It focuses on storing traffic laws, user queries, chatbot responses, and user feedback. The structure prioritizes simplicity and clarity for ease of maintenance and debugging. The structure is segregated to make authorization and security rules easier to write and understand, as all documents in the same collection have the same rules.

Authorization Independence is achieved by avoiding hierarchical dependencies.  Since all user data is public, Authorization Independence is not applicable.

QAPs (Rules are not Filters): The structure enables secure `list` operations. Given the nature of the data (traffic laws, queries, responses, feedback), there is no need to enforce any complex list operations.
